final_verification.optional_pro_skips: All seven Core optional-Pro skips are exercised by the fresh paired-source 60-test run. Pro license boundary patched only in offline tests; production gate unchanged.
final_verification.evidence_granularity: Commands, observed exits/footers and file inventories retained; no claim to have archived every stdout chunk. Concurrent run totals overlap and are not summed as distinct tests.

guarantees: Native training pins supervision before process creation, inherits bounded shared lease and worker-only lineage FDs, validates READY before compute allocation receipt, then publishes exact running binding before final local checks and GO.
Lineage reads follow GO and name the actual worker PID. Supervisor closes its worker-only writer copy before READY so it cannot falsely prolong lineage EOF.

Training completion, failed launch, requeue, monitor and shutdown require the phase-qualified exact current closure before reading/copying artifacts or recording terminal compute/lifecycle effects; rechecked inside publication transaction.
Natural root exit is insufficient; actual detached CPU writer must close. Explicit STOP cannot become success even if worker root returned zero; automatic VRAM retry is blocked after STOP.

Supervision uncertainty retains active work, launch intent and reservations without inferred NOT_STARTED or blind retry. Worker-root zombie/GPU watchdog heuristics cannot reject activity of adopted descendants.
Mutable is_posthoc does not reroute persisted active native training authority. Retained prelaunch history does not override a present running lifecycle in failure reporting.

verification_layers.baseline_and_replays: Complete old d915 training/launcher/completion/process files are preserved and replayed with two failures/two controls. Draft full-module snapshots reproduce phase/resume, optional None and report defects in memory without source writes.
verification_layers.fixture_migrations: Nine explicit old files, 172 original Assert AST nodes and five mock assertion source calls preserved. Fault seam changes are disclosed; simulation never supplies the real CPU closure proof.
verification_layers.independent_reviews: Shared adapter/FD authorship is separate from independent root-integration checks. Final bounded targets: runtime 13 passed/12.76s, routing 22 passed/13.15s, shared compatibility 107 passed/67.96s; overlapping counts are not summed.
verification_layers.artifact_audit: Four supporting reports, 25 decoded commands syntax-checked; 24 unique report snapshot links hash-matched. All 27 complete C2b source/test snapshots parse; root audit includes the other three. Original whitespace retained even where snapshot-only diff --check reports it.
verification_layers.failed_epochs: Full epoch 1 had 16 failed,2993 passed,7 skipped and is explicitly excluded. Complete epoch-1 inventory and results retained; only epoch 2 source/test freeze is final acceptance.

limits: Only new native training plus unchanged native evaluation compatibility. Legacy unbound attempts cannot be silently adopted.
Posthoc, pre/post scripts, director/startup OS control, durable recovery/adoption, consumer ACK and observation selection remain open.

No actual GPU allocation, training model, paid provider or research campaign was run. CPU subprocess/nonce/flock evidence does not prove model quality, kernel isolation or measured research efficiency.
Linux local supervisor semantics, not cross-host containment or malicious-code security. Input final checks are not an atomic snapshot or post-GO write sandbox.
Generic CPU experiment/analyze/replicate policy loop and independent holdout remain incomplete; holdout plaintext has not been read.
